notes.title: Repeating corridor
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we have noticed that a lot of you have problems with a repeating corridor. So, it isn't a game bug, the room where the painting falling, you should find the change in the room. Some rooms will repeat forever until you will not find the change. What is better, make the door just closed or make infinite corridor if didn't do something that game needs? We just wanted to make the game different from another "P.T." style games,  but a lot of you accept these features like bugs. A lot of people don't like the game and we apologize for that.

If you have problems with the walkthrough but still want to pass the game, we have posted a video on our YouTube channel with gameplay. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1069m4Qm_I]Gameplay[/url]

Best regards,
Souluted Games

notes.title: Information about suspending sales of Diastone games series
notes.notes:
Hello! It's time for the bad news. At the moment Diastone has two games: [b]Diastone: Confusion[/b], [b]Diastone: Memories[/b]. We want to relaunch the games series and that reason to suspend sales of the Diastone games. We have a huge plan that we going to start completing in the near year and more. Also, we will remake Diastone: Memories and will make it in much more level of quality. Diastone: Confusion won't be involved in the games series. In the near time will be available news about developing a new game, you can follow us on twitter to know about them one of the first. 

[url=https://twitter.com/souluted]Twitter[/url]

Best Ragards,
Souluted Games
